2. Mathematical Specification  
Let \( h \in \mathbb{R}^{n_{points}} \) with \( h_i \in [0,1] \) and \( \sum h_i = n_{points}/2, \).  
The objective is:  
\[
C_5 = \max_{k} \sum_{i} h_i (1 - h_{i + k}) \Delta x
\]  
Subject to:  
\[
\sum_{i=0}^{n-1} h_i = n_{points}/2
\]
\[
0 \leq h_i \leq 1
\]
